newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PAL announces open offer.
newsitem.headline: PAL announces open offer.

text.p: Process Automation Hong Kong Ltd (PAL) said on Monday that Optimist International Ltd had purchased 133.42 million PAL shares, or 42.5 percent, from six PAL executive directors, and was making an open offer to shareholders to raise cash and rationalise its shareholder base.
It said Optimist, a company formed by PAL's six executive directors, had paid HK$0.53 each for the shares by issuing new Optimist shares to PAL directors.
PAL said Optimist was now extending the offer to shareholders.
It was issuing 104.75 million new open offer shares at HK$0.53 a share, offering one open offer share for every three PAL HK$0.10 shares, PAL said.
PAL said the transaction was intended to consolidate the shareholder base and to raise HK$55.5 million before expenses.

It said the HK$0.53 issue price was a 45.9 percent discount to the closing price of the shares on April 25, the last day they were traded. Trading in shares of electroplating machines distributor PAL was suspended on April 28.
PAL said the offer was also intended to consolidate the shareholder base.
It said PAL proposed to lift a six-month moratorium on convertible loan noteholders to allow them to take part in the offer.
PAL said HK$15 million of the initial net proceeds would be used for working capital and to cut bank borrowings. The remainder would be used to diversify PAL's businesses, PAL said.
